name: print-social-navy-and-teal-business-webinar-posts-with-pill-photos
title: Navy business webinar pack with pill-shaped photo crops, teal text and outline arrows
whatItIs: Nine navy square posts with 'We bet on the companies of the future' where 'companies' is teal, people photos cropped into wide pills and arches, periwinkle circles, thin outlined circle arrows and small event details.
whatItMeans: Calm and modern; soft pill crops make a corporate event feel approachable.
techniques: Crop portraits into pills and arches.
Colour one word of the headline in a fresh accent.
Use outlined circles with arrows as directional marks.
Repeat layout with swapped photo shapes across the set.
